note: Section-level source map for material quantitative and interpretive claims. Exact artifact values are reconciled cell by cell in source-cell-audit.json; report claims were checked against the frozen chapter PDFs. The map does not certify future revisions.

sections.heading: How large was foreign investment beside India's own investment?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: US_FdiFlowsStock.csv; Economy Label=India, Flow Label=Flow, Direction Label=Inward, Percentage of gross Fixed Capital Formation and Millions of US$; 1990-2025
sections.interpretationLimit: FDI/GFCF compares two aggregate flows and does not allocate finance to assets.

sections.heading: Where does India sit among the developing regions, over fifty-six years?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: World Bank BX.KLT.DINV.WD.GD.ZS.json; countryiso3code IND, LCN, EAS, SSF; 1970-2025
sections.interpretationLimit: Regional values are weighted aggregates; national source data overlap with UNCTAD.

sections.heading: Did India climb at all?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: US_FdiFlowsStock.csv; all individual economies, Flow/Inward/Millions of US$; 1990-2025; exclude 16 Caribbean financial centres listed in audit-sources.py; compare WIR 2026 chapter I figure I.4
sections.interpretationLimit: Rank depends on reporting set and exclusions; 2025 report lists India 11th.

sections.heading: How does India compare with countries that drew more FDI?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: US_FdiFlowsStock.csv; India, Viet Nam, Poland, China, Republic of Korea; Flow/Inward/Percentage of gross Fixed Capital Formation
sections.interpretationLimit: Ratio is a scale comparison, not an attribution of fixed investment to FDI.

sections.heading: Is India unusual in its own neighbourhood?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: US_FdiFlowsStock.csv; India, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh; Flow/Inward/Percentage of gross Fixed Capital Formation; 1990-2025
sections.interpretationLimit: Small or crisis-hit denominators can raise the ratio.

sections.heading: What does all of it add up to, per Indian?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: US_FdiFlowsStock.csv; sum each economy's 1990-2025 Flow/Inward/Millions of US$; US_PopTotal.csv 2025 population
sections.interpretationLimit: A 36-year cumulative flow divided by one-year population is a scale comparison, not a lifetime receipt.

sections.heading: Did the shift toward Southeast Asia lift India's FDI?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: US_FdiFlowsStock.csv; Developing economies: South-eastern Asia, China, India; Flow/Inward/Millions of US$; compare 2013-2017 with 2021-2025; WIR 2026 chapter I, pp. 28-29
sections.interpretationLimit: FDI totals cannot trace factory relocations; aggregate includes Singapore.

sections.heading: Is India gaining on its actual competitors?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: US_FdiFlowsStock.csv; India and Developing economies; Flow/Inward/Millions of US$; India divided by aggregate for each year
sections.interpretationLimit: Denominator excludes Caribbean financial centres but includes Singapore and other routing hubs.

sections.heading: How large is India's accumulated FDI stock?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: US_FdiFlowsStock.csv; selected economy rows, Stock/Inward/Percentage of gross Domestic Product; 2025
sections.interpretationLimit: Stock/GDP is a book-value-to-output ratio, not an asset ownership fraction.

sections.heading: What do the acquisition figures add?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: WIR 2026 annex table 05, India seller economy row, 1990-2025; US_FdiFlowsStock.csv, India Flow/Inward/Millions of US$
sections.interpretationLimit: Cross-border acquisitions can contribute to FDI, but deal values and balance-of-payments flows use different compilation and timing; do not subtract the two series or use them to decompose annual FDI.

sections.heading: Why do the announcements not match the arrivals?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: WIR 2026 annex tables 14 and 17, India destination row, 2003-2025; WIR 2026 chapter I, box I.4 p. 28; US_FdiFlowsStock.csv, India Flow/Inward/Millions of US$
sections.interpretationLimit: Project announcements are intentions; Google/Hynfra and manufacturing announcement values do not explain recorded FDI.

sections.heading: Which era actually worked?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: US_FdiFlowsStock.csv; India Flow/Inward and Flow/Outward/Millions of US$, plus annual Percentage of gross Fixed Capital Formation; editorial periods 1991-2000, 2001-2008, 2009-2014, 2015-2020, 2021-2025
sections.interpretationLimit: Sum flows but average annual ratios without weighting; boundaries are editorial, not causal policy periods.

sections.heading: Do Indian firms build abroad?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: WIR 2026 annex tables 13 and 14, India source and destination rows, 2003-2025
sections.interpretationLimit: Both measures are announced greenfield projects, not completed investments.

sections.heading: What does it mean that India now invests abroad too?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: US_FdiFlowsStock.csv; India Stock/Inward and Stock/Outward/Millions of US$; 1990, 2010, 2025
sections.interpretationLimit: Stock values are book values and cannot distinguish overseas operations from holding structures.

sections.heading: Where are the Indian multinationals?
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: WIR 2026 annex tables 19 and 20, Home economy column; 2024 list
sections.interpretationLimit: Counts are from foreign-asset rankings, not a census of multinationals or exports.

sections.heading: How to read these numbers: methodology and caveats
sections.sourceRowsOrPages: WIR 2026 chapter I, box I.1 pp. 6-7; US_FdiFlowsStock metadata; World Bank indicator BX.KLT.DINV.WD.GD.ZS metadata
sections.interpretationLimit: Definitions and source-vintage limitations apply to all preceding sections.
